notes.title: Update new Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hello Time Traveler.
We have a few updates that make our brave warriors happier

 Support more resolution.
 Portrait art option.  our brave warriors can change Portrait between original and anime
 Fixed Joystick support

Anyway, there may be a few more bugs that may slip through our tests. Please report them in the discussion. We will try our best to clean them all.
Cheers.
ABI Dev Team
